text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ooooh. I'm getting nervous...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I... might not be...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm the one who decided to run
this race
and face Teio head-on...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It would be so embarrassing if I lose
this.
Not that
I think worrying about this is
any less lame.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, come on!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You always say that. Don't you have
anything
better to say? Something more
insightful?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still... Thanks. I might not believe in
myself...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But I'll try to remember that you have
faith in me.

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Employee
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Um, yes, sure.

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Employee
text_block_list.text:
There has been a change in the runner
list.

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Employee
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio withdrew from the race.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: What?! Teio's not running?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Wh-why?

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Employee
text_block_list.text:
We don't know the details yet, but... it
seems that
she recently injured herself.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, no...

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Employee
text_block_list.text:
That's all I can say for now! Now,
if you'll
excuse
me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No way... Teio isn't... competing?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Is she okay? Was it really bad? What
should I—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yikes. I'm getting all jumbled.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I can't!
I was finally ready to face her...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gosh... What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Who should I chase after now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until this point, Nice Nature's target
has been beating Tokai Teio. I can
understand her
confusion upon hearing
the news, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But... I can't just run... Our plan was to
follow
Teio...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I know, I know... But...
choice_data_list: Teio isn't running in this one.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: All the more reason to win!
All the more reason you have to win!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature is too fixated on running
with Tokai
Teio right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having a goal to aim for is key to
growth, but a fixation on that goal leads
to stagnation. To go
beyond that, she
needs to broaden her sights.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: My own...
choice_data_list: Let's just make sure you run your ...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uuurgh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, that really got to me for a second.
So
embarrassing.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm honestly still shaken up... but I
promise I'll run
a solid race...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm done being lame!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I will!
